back: The system treats all groups equitably — training data and outcomes are checked so no demographic is systematically disadvantaged. Keyword: bias.
The system works dependably even in unexpected conditions — rigorous testing before release, especially where errors cause real harm. Keyword: testing.
Personal data used in training and inference is protected, minimised, and access-controlled.
AI should empower everyone, including people with disabilities — e.g. vision models describing the world to blind users.
People are told how the system works, its limitations, and when they are talking to AI rather than a human.
People and organisations stay answerable for what their AI does — governance, human review, and appeal routes, not "the model decided".
Trained on vast data, they repeatedly predict the most probable next token — producing plausible output, not guaranteed truth.
Match capability to need: multimodal for image/audio input; smaller models are cheaper and faster for simple tasks; larger models reason better at higher cost.
Deployment parameter controlling randomness: low = focused and repeatable, high = varied and creative.
Generative AI creates content (drafts, images, code). Agentic AI takes a goal, reasons about steps, and uses tools to act — it books the meeting, not just drafts the invite.
Surfaces the main terms and phrases in a document — a list of what it's about, without classifying them.
Finds and classifies named things in text — people, places, organisations, dates.
Scores text as positive, negative, or neutral — the triage tool for reviews and feedback.
Condenses long text while keeping its meaning — readable prose, not a term list.
Recognition (speech-to-text): audio → text, for dictation and captions. Synthesis (text-to-speech): text → natural spoken audio with neural voices.
Classification labels the whole image; detection finds each object and localises it with bounding regions.
Turns unstructured content — documents, forms, images, audio, video — into structured data fields.
The platform for building Azure AI solutions: model catalog and portal, SDK for code, and Foundry Tools for capabilities like speech and content understanding.
System prompt: standing role, tone, and boundaries for the whole conversation. User prompt: the actual request each turn.
Specificity about task, format, and context — and including an example of good output beats clever phrasing.
Makes a catalog model callable at an endpoint — used by both the portal playground and your applications.
The Foundry portal's interactive space for trying prompts and settings against a deployed model before writing code.
Models are stateless — each call sees only what's sent, so the client includes the conversation history (plus system prompt) every time.
A model + instructions + optional tools and knowledge, able to reason toward goals and act — defined and testable in the portal.
Attaching knowledge (your documents/data) so the agent answers from them instead of only its general training.
Create a conversation thread → post the user message → run the agent → read the response. Same agent as the portal, driven from code.
Lightweight client sends text to deployed language capabilities (sentiment, entities, key phrases, summarization) and acts on the structured results.

front: Spoken prompts with a multimodal model
back: A deployed multimodal model accepts audio input directly — the user speaks, the model understands and answers, no separate transcription step in your code.
The dedicated speech service: speech-to-text for transcription and captions; text-to-speech with a catalogue of neural voices.
Attach an image to a prompt and ask about it — a multimodal model interprets the picture in the context of the instruction.
Deployed in Foundry, it creates new images from text descriptions — the opposite direction from interpreting existing images.
Foundry Tools service for information extraction: documents/forms, images, audio, and video in — structured fields out.
Reads fields from documents and forms — vendor, dates, totals, line items from invoices, ready for a database.
Transcribes recordings and extracts defined facts — names, numbers, commitments from call recordings.
Combines speech and visual extraction over the timeline — what was said and shown, when — as searchable structured data.
Define the schema of wanted fields → submit content for analysis → read structured results. Same loop for every modality.
The Foundry project's endpoint/connection and the name of the model deployment to call.
Catalog → deploy → playground experimentation → SDK client against the same deployment. What you tested is what ships.
A model that accepts more than text — images and/or audio in prompts — enabling vision Q&A and spoken interaction.
Deployment parameters capping how much the model reads and writes per call — part of configuring a deployment alongside temperature.
